name: 8085 Load and Add
desc: This is a simple 8085 assembly language program that loads the value 44H into register A and the value 08H into register B. It then adds the contents of register A and B and halts the program.

files.sketch.ino:
;  LOAD 44H to A register and 08H to B register. 
;  ADD the contents of register A and B. 

; CODE:
MVI A,44H    					
MVI B,08H					
ADD B						
HLT

; END OF CODE
